All results on this page use the models after exclusion of the two records for the common ostrich (6/6) and Nelson’s sparrow (8/8), whose exact counts could not be verified as broods with at least two genetic sires. Other records were retained, including the saltmarsh-sparrow record from the same Walsh study. Updated 5 November 2026.

Estimates are posterior means with 95% equal-tailed credible intervals (CrI). Odds ratios are summarised after exponentiating each contrast draw. Prevalence predictions are summarised after inverse-logit transformation, with random effects set to zero. Continuous effects use the original common scaling constants, retained unchanged after exclusion. Mixed paternity refers to the source-derived brood-level measure described in Methods; source reporting sometimes used brood-level EPP without identifying sire number.

## Nest architecture

585 records, 525 study identifiers and 348 species; 15687 mixed-paternity broods out of 44233 sampled broods.

| Coefficient | Mean log odds [95% CrI] | Mean OR [95% CrI] |
| --- | --- | --- |
| nest type modelcavity | -1.549 [-3.668, 0.572] | 0.378 [0.026, 1.773] |
| nest type modelground | -1.342 [-3.410, 0.737] | 0.462 [0.033, 2.089] |
| nest type modelopen | -1.540 [-3.644, 0.554] | 0.380 [0.026, 1.740] |
| nest type modelother enclosed | -1.771 [-3.933, 0.361] | 0.311 [0.020, 1.434] |

### Pairwise contrasts

Each contrast compares the first category with the second.

| Contrast | Mean log odds [95% CrI] | Mean OR [95% CrI] |
| --- | --- | --- |
| cavity - ground | -0.207 [-0.751, 0.335] | 0.845 [0.472, 1.398] |
| cavity - open | -0.009 [-0.434, 0.424] | 1.015 [0.648, 1.528] |
| cavity - other enclosed | 0.222 [-0.400, 0.854] | 1.314 [0.670, 2.349] |
| ground - open | 0.198 [-0.302, 0.699] | 1.258 [0.740, 2.012] |
| ground - other enclosed | 0.429 [-0.217, 1.085] | 1.623 [0.805, 2.960] |
| open - other enclosed | 0.231 [-0.341, 0.814] | 1.317 [0.711, 2.257] |

### Conditional prevalence

| Category | Prevalence (%) [95% CrI] |
| --- | --- |
| cavity | 21.810 [2.490, 63.933] |
| ground | 24.856 [3.198, 67.628] |
| open | 21.916 [2.548, 63.510] |
| other enclosed | 18.910 [1.921, 58.918] |

### Variance components and precision

| Quantity | Posterior mean [95% CrI] |
| --- | --- |
| Phylogenetic species variance | 3.561 [1.920, 5.664] |
| Non-phylogenetic species variance | 0.435 [0.160, 0.770] |
| Study variance | 0.068 [0.000, 0.218] |
| Beta-binomial precision | 18.782 [12.224, 32.989] |
| Species-level phylogenetic heritability | 0.882 [0.743, 0.968] |
